gaps: Debussy’s own Welte-Mignon rolls (1913, incl. Children’s Corner): no rights-clean audio. IA HSTR-5370 (“Welte legacy of piano treasures: Debussy and Ravel perform in 1913”) holds no audio files at all; the Telefunken “Welte-Mignon 1905” LP items (1971) postdate the 1963 cut; Stanford SUPRA-RW is CC BY-NC-SA.

Bartók’s own playing: the IA compilation “Bela Bartok plays Bartok” holds one 5-minute file (Romanian Folk Dances with Szigeti) without provenance; Commons “Contrasts” is a 46-second fragment. Contrasts (Bartók/Szigeti/Goodman 1940) not found on a free source.

Debussy Pelléas et Mélisande complete: only the 1927 Coppola excerpts (Panzéra/Brothier, W 838, W 840, IA 02-brothier-panzera-duet-pellas-act-3-w-840 and w-838-panzera-ah-je-respire-enfin) and a 1960 Morel / 1962 Fournet set of unclear provenance.

No free recording found for anything born after about 1920: Pärt, Reich, Adams, Adès, Feldman, Gubaidulina, Kurtág, Saariaho. Ligeti and Boulez: nothing free before 1963. The one Boulez LP (Le marteau sans maître, Odyssey 1958) is an access-restricted IA item (files private, collection samples_only) and was dropped.
